descriptionHtml:
This stunning plus size chiffon guest dress features a modern high low hemline, a flattering V-neckline, and delicate ruffle sleeves for a romantic touch. Perfect for any wedding, this dress will make you feel beautiful and elegant.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi length/High-low.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
